label: Education
assignment: Discover realistic education resources for people in {service_area} who need literacy, language learning, a high-school equivalency, postsecondary education, trades, credentials, scholarships, or accessible learning. Follow institutions to specific programs and funding pathways, verifying prerequisites, cost, aid, schedules, format, accommodations, and enrollment deadlines.
include: Adult literacy, English-language learning, tutoring, and digital literacy
GED or high-school completion and adult education
College, career, trade, apprenticeship, credential, and continuing-education pathways
Scholarships, grants, tuition assistance, advising, testing, and application help
Evening, online, disability-accessible, multilingual, reentry, and other barrier-aware options
exclude: General school or college homepages without a specific accessible program or enrollment path
Commercial courses with unclear accreditation, cost, completion, or employment value
Expired scholarships or enrollment opportunities presented as currently available
